cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Hand Over the Proof
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender information, evidence, a key, or access that would let you proceed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Give me the note about cancelling my exhibition space. I need to see what the curator actually wrote.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It says, 'You can't exhibit unless the committee agrees.' They won't.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Her words finish at 'agrees'? Your prediction isn't part of the note. Hand me the page, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There's personal stuff about me on the page. I'm not handing that over.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fold your part underneath and let me read the condition. We can discuss your forecast afterwards.

reason: Final reread replaces B2's fragment with a complete quoted condition, making the stakes of direct access explicit. All other dialogue and the underlying task are preserved.
